plain: Keyboard focus no longer moves controls, CodeBlock is no longer a landmark unless its code scrolls, and Button label now names the button.

steps.plain: A CodeBlock is no longer a region named Code sample with its own tab stop; it becomes a keyboard-scrollable group named by its filename or language only when its code overflows. Update any test or selector that looked for that region.

Button label now sets the accessible name whenever it is given, even with children; a Button that passes both label and children is announced by the label, so make sure it still describes the visible text.
